```{r setup, include=FALSE}

new_theme <- function() {
  
  # Set the core colors
  color.background = "white"
  color.grid.major = "gray70"
  color.axis.text = "gray30"
  color.axis.title = "gray50"
  color.title = "gray30"
  
  # Other key values
  theme_bw(base_size=18) +
    theme(text=element_text(family="Helvetica")) +
    
    # Set the backrgound
    theme(panel.background=element_rect(fill=color.background, color=color.background)) +
    theme(plot.background=element_rect(fill=color.background, color=color.background)) +
    theme(panel.border=element_rect(color=color.background)) +
    
    # Format the grid
    theme(panel.grid.major.y=element_line(color=color.grid.major,size=.25)) +
    theme(panel.grid.major.x=element_blank()) +
    theme(panel.grid.minor=element_blank()) +
    theme(axis.ticks=element_blank()) +
    theme(strip.background = element_rect(fill="white"))+
    
    # Format the legend, bottom by default
    theme(legend.position="bottom") +
    theme(legend.background = element_rect(fill=color.background)) +
    theme(legend.key = element_rect(colour = 'white')) +
    theme(legend.text = element_text(size=18,color=color.axis.title)) +
    
    # Set title and axis labels, and format these and tick marks
    theme(plot.title=element_text(color=color.title, size=18, vjust=1.25)) +
    theme(axis.text.x=element_text(size=18,color=color.axis.text)) +
    theme(axis.text.y=element_text(size=18,color=color.axis.text)) +
    theme(axis.title.x=element_text(size=18,color=color.axis.title, vjust=0)) +
    theme(axis.title.y=element_text(size=18,color=color.axis.title, vjust=1.25)) 
}

my_theme <- function(base_size = 14, base_family = "sans"){
  theme_minimal(base_size = base_size, base_family = base_family) +
    theme(
      axis.text = element_text(size=14),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 0.5),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 16),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey"),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "#2a3132", color = "#2a3132", size=1.5),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16, color = "white"),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.justification = "center",
      legend.background = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "grey30", fill = NA, size = 0.5)
    )
}
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(vegan)
library(plyr)
library(dplyr)
library(viridis)
library(reshape2)
library(ape)
library(FactoMineR)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(multcomp)
library(readr)
library(gtools)
library(cowplot)
library(ggpubr)
library(devtools)
library(maaslin3)
#library(Maaslin2)
#library(maaslin3)
library(ggExtra)
library(PMCMRplus)

# Load metadata and feature tables
metadata <- read.delim(sep=',',"231101_MasterGFmappingfileCLEAN.csv",header=TRUE,stringsAsFactors = F)
DF_widespecies<-read.delim(sep=',',header=T,"Metaphlan3/November2023COMBINEDspecieswide.csv",stringsAsFactors = F)
Othermissing<-anti_join(DF_widespecies,metadata, by="Sample")
metadata<-subset(metadata, Total_Postprocessed_Reads > 50000) 
metadata<-subset(metadata, !Notes=="Contaminated")
DF_longspecies<-read.delim(sep=',',header=T,"Metaphlan3/231120_COMBINEDmetaphlanStandard_species.csv",stringsAsFactors = F)
DF_widegenus<-read.delim(sep=',',header=T,"Metaphlan3/November2023COMBINEDgenuswide.csv",stringsAsFactors = F)
DF_longgenus<-read.delim(sep=',',header=T,"Metaphlan3/231120_COMBINEDmetaphlanStandard_genus.csv",stringsAsFactors = F)
DF_widefamily<-read.delim(sep=',',header=T,"Metaphlan3/November2023COMBINEDfamilywide.csv",stringsAsFactors = F)
DF_longfamily<-read.delim(sep=',',header=T,"Metaphlan3/231120_COMBINEDmetaphlanStandard_family.csv",stringsAsFactors = F)

#Calculate richness and Shannon Diversity and create a new dataframe
row.names(DF_widespecies)<-DF_widespecies$Sample
DF_widespecies$Sample<-NULL

SpeciesrichDiv<-data.frame(
  Sample=row.names(DF_widespecies),
  shannon=diversity(DF_widespecies),
  speciesrichness=specnumber(DF_widespecies)
)
DF_widespecies$Sample<-row.names(DF_widespecies)

row.names(DF_widegenus)<-DF_widegenus$Sample
DF_widegenus$Sample<-NULL

genusrich<-data.frame(
  Sample=row.names(DF_widegenus),
  genusrichness=specnumber(DF_widegenus)
)
DF_widegenus$Sample<-row.names(DF_widegenus)

row.names(DF_widefamily)<-DF_widefamily$Sample
DF_widefamily$Sample<-NULL

familyrich<-data.frame(
  Sample=row.names(DF_widefamily),
  familyrichness=specnumber(DF_widefamily)
)
DF_widefamily$Sample<-row.names(DF_widefamily)

#Join together all the richnesses and shannon into the metadata
#Merge with metadata
DF_widemetaspecies<-join(metadata, DF_widespecies, by = "Sample")
DF_widemetaspecies<-join(DF_widemetaspecies,SpeciesrichDiv, by = "Sample")
#write.csv(DF_widemetaspecies, "240809_DF_widemetaspecies.csv")
DF_longmetaspecies<-join(metadata, DF_longspecies, by = "Sample")
DF_widemetagenus<-join(metadata, DF_widegenus, by = "Sample")
DF_widemetagenus<-join(DF_widemetagenus,genusrich, by = "Sample")
DF_longmetagenus<-join(metadata, DF_longgenus, by = "Sample")
DF_widemetafamily<-join(metadata, DF_widefamily, by = "Sample")
DF_widemetafamily<-join(DF_widemetafamily,familyrich, by = "Sample")
DF_longmetafamily<-join(metadata, DF_longfamily, by = "Sample")
```

```{r}
##Human PCOA to identify representative microbiota for use in mouse model##
Humanmetadata<-read.delim("data/input/250925_DrewGMollyGDrewSNICUBSICHMNECmetadata_meropenemexposure.csv",sep=",")
row.names(Humanmetadata)<-Humanmetadata$Row.names
Combinedhumanspecies<-read.delim("data/input/Metaphlan3/251118_DrewGMollyGDrewSThanertcombined.csv",sep=",")
Combinedhumanspecies$Row.names<-Combinedhumanspecies$Sample
row.names(Combinedhumanspecies)<-Combinedhumanspecies$Row.names
Combinedhumanspecies$X<-NULL
Combinedhumanspecies$Sample<-NULL

#Subset to samples in first month of life
Humanmetadataunder30DOL<-subset(Humanmetadata,DOL<=30)
Humanmetadataunder30DOLspecies<-join(Humanmetadataunder30DOL,Combinedhumanspecies, by="Row.names")
row.names(Humanmetadataunder30DOLspecies)<-Humanmetadataunder30DOLspecies$Row.names
Humanmetadataunder30DOLspeciesclean<-Humanmetadataunder30DOLspecies[,-c(1:16)]
Humanmetadataunder30DOLspeciesclean<-Humanmetadataunder30DOLspeciesclean[, colSums(Humanmetadataunder30DOLspeciesclean) !=0]
#Now to perform a PCOA on these data#
BrayDFhumanless30 <-vegdist(Humanmetadataunder30DOLspeciesclean, method = "bray")
pco.brayDFhumanless30<-labdsv::pco(BrayDFhumanless30, k=4)
BrayDFhumanless30<-as.data.frame(pco.brayDFhumanless30$points)
BrayDFhumanless30$Row.names<-row.names(BrayDFhumanless30)
Humanmetadataunder30DOLspeciesclean$Row.names<-row.names(Humanmetadataunder30DOLspeciesclean)
pco.brayDFhumanless30meta<-join(BrayDFhumanless30,Humanmetadataunder30DOLspeciesclean, by="Row.names")

#Eigenvalues
EigenBrayDFhumanless30<-rbind(SD = sqrt(pco.brayDFhumanless30$eig),Proportion = pco.brayDFhumanless30$eig/sum(pco.brayDFhumanless30$eig),Cumulative = cumsum(pco.brayDFhumanless30$eig)/sum(pco.brayDFhumanless30$eig))
#V1 = 22%
#V2 = 16%

#add on dominant genera as a feature to have a color in the PCOA

pco.brayDFhumanless30meta |> dplyr::mutate(Dominant_genus = 
                                        case_when(Escherichia_coli + 
                                                    Escherichia_marmotae + 
                                                    Escherichia_sp_ESNIH1 > 50 ~ "Escherichia",
                                                  Klebsiella_aerogenes + 
                                                    Klebsiella_michiganensis + 
                                                    Klebsiella_oxytoca + 
                                                    Klebsiella_pneumoniae + 
                                                    Klebsiella_quasipneumoniae + 
                                                    Klebsiella_variicola + 
                                                    Klebsiella_variicola_CAG_634 + 
                                                    Klebsiella_grimontii > 50 ~ "Klebsiella",
                                                  Enterococcus_avium + 
                                                    Enterococcus_faecalis + 
                                                    Enterococcus_faecium +  
                                                    Enterococcus_gallinarum + 
                                                    Enterococcus_italicus +  
                                                    Enterococcus_raffinosus + 
                                                    Enterococcus_casseliflavus + 
                                                    Enterococcus_malodoratus > 50 ~ "Enterococcus",
                                                  Staphylococcus_argenteus + 
                                                    Staphylococcus_aureus + 
                                                    Staphylococcus_capitis + 
                                                    Staphylococcus_caprae + 
                                                    Staphylococcus_epidermidis + 
                                                    Staphylococcus_haemolyticus + 
                                                    Staphylococcus_hominis + 
                                                    Staphylococcus_lugdunensis + 
                                                    Staphylococcus_pasteuri + 
                                                    Staphylococcus_pettenkoferi + 
                                                    Staphylococcus_warneri + 
                                                    Staphylococcus_simulans > 50 ~ "Staphylococcus",
                                                  Bifidobacterium_adolescentis + 
                                                    Bifidobacterium_bifidum + 
                                                    Bifidobacterium_breve +
                                                    Bifidobacterium_dentium + 
                                                    Bifidobacterium_longum + 
                                                    Bifidobacterium_pseudocatenulatum + 
                                                    Bifidobacterium_adolescentis + 
                                                    Bifidobacterium_catenulatum + 
                                                    Bifidobacterium_scardovii + 
                                                    Bifidobacterium_kashiwanohense + 
                                                    Bifidobacterium_pseudolongum > 50 ~ "Bifidobacterium",
                                                  .default = "Diverse"), .after = Row.names) -> pco.brayDFhumanless30meta_wDominant

ggplot(pco.brayDFhumanless30meta_wDominant, aes(x=V1, y=V2, color=Dominant_genus)) + geom_point(size=2)+
  theme_bw()+theme(legend.text=element_text(size=12, face="bold"),legend.title=element_text(size=14, face="bold"),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black"), 
        axis.text.x= element_text(size=12,angle=45,hjust=1,vjust=1,face="bold"),
        axis.text.y= element_text(size=12,face="bold"))+scale_fill_manual(values=genuscolors)+
  ylab("PCO2 (16%)")+
  xlab("PCO1 (22%)") 

#Add mouse microbiota A thru D as a designation
humanmousePCOAlessthan30meta<-read.delim("260109humanlessthan30withmouse.csv",sep=",")

ggplot(humanmousePCOAlessthan30meta, aes(x=V1, y=V2, color=Dominant_genus)) + geom_point(size=1)+
  theme_bw()+theme(legend.text=element_text(size=12, face="bold"),legend.title=element_text(size=14, face="bold"),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black"), 
        axis.text.x= element_text(size=12,angle=45,hjust=1,vjust=1,face="bold"),
        axis.text.y= element_text(size=12,face="bold"))+scale_color_manual(values=genuscolors)+geom_point(data = subset(humanmousePCOAlessthan30meta, Microbiota %in% c("A", "B", "C","D")),
             , size =5)+
  ylab("PCO2 (16%)")+
  xlab("PCO1 (22%)")
ggsave(file="figures/260111_humanmicrobiotalessthan30mousemicrobiota.pdf")
```

```{r}
#PLot richness and diversity for Microbiota A inocula, dams, pups

MicroAwidespeciesadultbeforebirth<-subset(MicroAwidespecies, Adult=="yes"|DOL=="10"|DOL=="INOC")
MicroAwidespeciesadultbeforebirth$Collection<-as.numeric(MicroAwidespeciesadultbeforebirth$Collection)
MicroAwidespeciesadultbeforebirth<-subset(MicroAwidespeciesadultbeforebirth, Adult=="yes"&Collection<=31)
MicroAwidespeciesadultbeforebirth<-subset(MicroAwidespeciesadultbeforebirth,Sex=="F")
MicroAwidespeciesadultbeforebirth<-subset(MicroAwidespeciesadultbeforebirth,!Experiment=="gnoto3")


ggplot(MicroAwidespeciesadultbeforebirth, aes(x=Collection, y=speciesrichness)) + geom_point()+geom_smooth()+ ggtitle("Richness")+xlab("Days after gavage")+ylab("Richness") + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))+theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size=16), axis.title.x=element_text(size=20), axis.title.y = element_text(size=20), axis.text.y = element_text(size=16), axis.title = element_text(size=24))

#Average value INOC and adults

quantile(MicroAwidespeciesINOC$speciesrichness)

#  10   14   18   20   20

quantile(MicroAwidespeciesINOC$shannon)
```

```{r}
#plot Shortbred antibiotic resistance genes (beta lactams)
ABX_wide<-read.delim("data/input/NICUmousewideRPKM.csv", sep = ",")
Shortbredmetadata<-join(metadata,ABX_wide, by ="Sample")

ShortbredmetadatamicroA<-subset(Shortbredmetadata,Microbiota=="A")
ShortbredmetadatamicroA<-subset(ShortbredmetadatamicroA,DOL<15)
ShortbredmetadatamicroA<-subset(ShortbredmetadatamicroA, Abx_relativeinfxn=="aftermero"|Abx_relativeinfxn=="afteramp"|Abx_relativeinfxn=="afterPBS"|Abx_relativeinfxn=="afterpro"|Abx_relativeinfxn=="afterP")
ShortbredmetadatamicroA<-subset(ShortbredmetadatamicroA,!Antibiotic=="ampicillin")

ggplot(ShortbredmetadatamicroA, aes(x=Abx_relativeinfxn, y=Sum, color=Abx_relativeinfxn)) + geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +geom_point(position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.1)) +ggtitle("Total ARGs")+xlab("Timepoint")+ylab("Log total ARGs/sample") + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))+theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size=16), axis.title.x=element_text(size=20), axis.title.y = element_text(size=20), axis.text.y = element_text(size=16), axis.title = element_text(size=24))

ShortbredmetadataINOCDOL10<-subset(Shortbredmetadata,Microbiota=="A")
ShortbredmetadataINOCDOL10<-subset(ShortbredmetadataINOCDOL10,DOL=="10"|DOL=="INOC")
ShortbredmetadataINOCDOL10<-ShortbredmetadataINOCDOL10[!grepl("after", ShortbredmetadataINOCDOL10$Abx_relativeinfxn), ]
ShortbredmetadataINOCDOL10<-subset(ShortbredmetadataINOCDOL10, Tissue=="stool"|Tissue=="INOC")
ShortbredmetadataINOCDOL10$DOL[ShortbredmetadataINOCDOL10$DOL=="INOC"]<-"0"

ggplot(ShortbredmetadataINOCDOL10, aes(x=DOL, y=Count, color=DOL)) + geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +geom_point(position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.1)) +ggtitle("Total ARGs")+xlab("Timepoint")+ylab("Log total ARGs/sample") + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))+theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size=16), axis.title.x=element_text(size=20), axis.title.y = element_text(size=20), axis.text.y = element_text(size=16), axis.title = element_text(size=24))


#What about anything coded as "lactam"?
cols<-grep("lactam|Sample", names(ABX_wide), value = TRUE)
ShortbredBeta<-ABX_wide[,cols]

ShortbredBeta<- ShortbredBeta %>% mutate(Sum = rowSums(across(where(is.numeric))))
ShortbredBeta$Count<-sum(ShortbredBeta$score > 11, na.rm=TRUE)
ShortbredmetadataBeta<-join(metadata,ShortbredBeta, by ="Sample")

ShortbredmetadataBetamicroA<-subset(ShortbredmetadataBeta,Microbiota=="A")
ShortbredmetadataBetamicroA<-subset(ShortbredmetadataBetamicroA,DOL<15)
ShortbredmetadataBetamicroA<-subset(ShortbredmetadataBetamicroA, Abx_relativeinfxn=="aftermero"|Abx_relativeinfxn=="afteramp"|Abx_relativeinfxn=="afterPBS"|Abx_relativeinfxn=="afterpro"|Abx_relativeinfxn=="afterP")
ShortbredmetadataBetamicroA<-subset(ShortbredmetadataBetamicroA,!Antibiotic=="ampicillin")

ShortbredmetadataBetamicroAafteramp<-subset(ShortbredmetadataBetamicroA, Abx_relativeinfxn=="afteramp")
ShortbredmetadataBetamicroAaftermero<-subset(ShortbredmetadataBetamicroA, Abx_relativeinfxn=="aftermero")
ShortbredmetadataBetamicroAafterampmero<-rbind(ShortbredmetadataBetamicroAafteramp,ShortbredmetadataBetamicroAaftermero)

wilcox.test(ShortbredmetadataBetamicroAafterampmero$Sum~ShortbredmetadataBetamicroAafterampmero$Abx_relativeinfxn)
#W = 35, p-value = 0.02103
# alternative hypothesis: true location shift is not equal to 0

ggplot(ShortbredmetadataBetamicroA, aes(x=Abx_relativeinfxn, y=Sum, color=Abx_relativeinfxn)) + geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +geom_point(position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.5)) +ggtitle("Beta lactam ARGs")+xlab("Timepoint")+ylab("total beta lactam ARGs RPKM/sample") + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))+theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size=16), axis.title.x=element_text(size=20), axis.title.y = element_text(size=20), axis.text.y = element_text(size=16), axis.title = element_text(size=24))+scale_x_discrete(limits=c("afteramp","aftermero"))
ggsave(file="figures/250514_BetaLactammicroAafterampmerp.pdf")
```

```{r}
#Microbiota B analysis
MicroBwidespeciesadultbeforebirth<-subset(MicroBwidespecies, Adult=="yes"|DOL=="10"|DOL=="INOC")
```

```{r}
#PCOA of Bray-curtis with DOL10 pre-treatment samples and all inocula from Micro A-D
MicroABCDDOL10INOCMeta<-subset(DF_widemetaspecies, Microbiota=="A"|Microbiota=="B"|Microbiota=="C"|Microbiota=="D")
MicroABCDDOL10INOCMeta<-subset(MicroABCDDOL10INOCMeta, DOL=="10"|DOL=="INOC")
MicroABCDDOL10INOCMeta<-MicroABCDDOL10INOCMeta[!grepl("after", MicroABCDDOL10INOCMeta$Abx_relativeinfxn), ]
MicroABCDDOL10INOCMeta<-MicroABCDDOL10INOCMeta[!grepl("during", MicroABCDDOL10INOCMeta$Abx_relativeinfxn), ]
MicroABCDDOL10INOCMeta<-MicroABCDDOL10INOCMeta[!grepl("GF15", MicroABCDDOL10INOCMeta$Experiment), ]
MicroABCDDOL10INOCMeta<-MicroABCDDOL10INOCMeta[!grepl("GF17", MicroABCDDOL10INOCMeta$Experiment), ]
MicroABCDDOL10INOCMeta<-subset(MicroABCDDOL10INOCMeta, Tissue=="INOC"|Tissue=="stool")
MicroABCDDOL10INOCMeta<-MicroABCDDOL10INOCMeta[!duplicated(MicroABCDDOL10INOCMeta$Sample),]
.rowNamesDF(MicroABCDDOL10INOCMeta)<-MicroABCDDOL10INOCMeta$Sample
write.csv(BrayDFABCDmeta)
#remove non-microbial columns to run PCoA
Bray<-MicroABCDDOL10INOCMeta[-c(1:39)]
Bray$shannon<-NULL
Bray$speciesrichness<-NULL
Bray<-Bray[, colSums(Bray != 0) > 0]
BrayDF <-vegdist(Bray, method = "bray")
pco.brayDF<-labdsv::pco(BrayDF, k=4)
BrayDFABCD<-as.data.frame(pco.brayDF$points)
BrayDFABCD$Sample<-row.names(BrayDFABCD)
BrayDFABCDmeta<-join(BrayDFABCD,MicroABCDDOL10INOCMeta, by="Sample")
BrayDFABCD$Sample<-NULL
write.csv(BrayDFABCDmeta,file ='data/output/BrayDFABCDmeta.csv')
#Eigenvalues
EigenBrayDFABCD<-rbind(SD = sqrt(pco.brayDF$eig),Proportion = pco.brayDF$eig/sum(pco.brayDF$eig),Cumulative = cumsum(pco.brayDF$eig)/sum(pco.brayDF$eig))
#V1 = 28.5%
#V2 = 21.5%

#Reorder levels
BrayDFABCDmeta$Microbiota=factor(BrayDFABCDmeta$Microbiota, levels = c("A","B","C","D"))

a<-ggplot(BrayDFABCDmeta, aes(x=V1, y=V2, color=Microbiota, shape=as.factor(Tissue))) + geom_point(size=2)+
  theme_bw()+theme(legend.text=element_text(size=12, face="bold"),legend.title=element_text(size=14, face="bold"),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black"), 
        axis.text.x= element_text(size=12,angle=45,hjust=1,vjust=1,face="bold"),
        axis.text.y= element_text(size=12,face="bold"))+
  ylab("PCO2 (21.5%)")+
  xlab("PCO1 (28.5%)") 
ggMarginal(a, type="boxplot", groupColour = TRUE, groupFill = TRUE, size = 5)
ggsave(file="figures/251016_BrayPCoAABCD.pdf") 

BrayDFABCDmeta$Description<-paste(BrayDFABCDmeta$Microbiota,BrayDFABCDmeta$Tissue,sep="_")

adonis2(BrayDFABCD~Microbiota, data = BrayDFABCDmeta, permutations = 999, method ="bray", na.rm=TRUE)  
#           Df  SumOfSqs       R2       F Pr(>F)
# Model      3 -66991125 -0.95177 -42.263  0.784
# Residual 260 137376592  1.95177               
# Total    263  70385468  1.00000     
adonis2(BrayDFABCD~Microbiota+Tissue, data = BrayDFABCDmeta, permutations = 999, method ="bray", na.rm=TRUE)  
#          Df  SumOfSqs       R2       F Pr(>F)
# Model      4 -59559355 -0.84619 -29.678  0.675
# Residual 259 129944823  1.84619               
# Total    263  70385468  1.00000 
adonis2(BrayDFABCD~Description, data = BrayDFABCDmeta, permutations = 999, method ="bray", na.rm=TRUE)
#           Df  SumOfSqs       R2       F Pr(>F)
# Model      7 -51087537 -0.72583 -15.381  0.707
# Residual 256 121473005  1.72583               
# Total    263  70385468  1.00000 

pairwise.wilcox.test(BrayDFABCDmeta$V1, BrayDFABCDmeta$Microbiota, p.adjust.method = "BH")
#     A       B       C      
# B  < 2e-16 -       -      
# C  3.7e-06 3.6e-10 -      
# D  3.6e-10 0.0031  1.0e-13
pairwise.wilcox.test(BrayDFABCDmeta$V2, BrayDFABCDmeta$Microbiota, p.adjust.method = "BH")
#     A       B       C      
#   B 1.9e-09 -       -      
#   C 6.3e-12 4.4e-06 -
```

```{r}
  ylab("PCO2 (22%)")+
  xlab("PCO1 (34%)") 
ggMarginal(b, type="boxplot", groupColour = FALSE, groupFill = TRUE, size = 5)
ggsave(file="figures/251212_BrayPCoAABvsAB.pdf") 

adonis2(BrayABDF~Microbiota, data = BrayABDFDmeta, permutations = 999, method ="bray", na.rm=TRUE)

pairwise.wilcox.test(BrayABDFDmeta$V1, BrayABDFDmeta$Microbiota, p.adjust.method = "BH")

pairwise.wilcox.test(BrayABDFDmeta$V2, BrayABDFDmeta$Microbiota, p.adjust.method = "BH")

MicroABlonggenusbeforemeroLIVEave <- MicroABlonggenusbeforemeroLIVEave[which(MicroABlonggenusbeforemeroLIVEave$abundance > 0),]
MicroABlonggenusbeforemeroLIVEave$normalabundance<-MicroABlonggenusbeforemeroLIVEave$abundance/sum(MicroABlonggenusbeforemeroLIVEave$abundance)*100

MicroABlonggenusbeforemeroDEADave<-aggregate(abundance~Sample + Survived + taxa + Abx_relativeinfxn, data= MicroABlonggenusbeforemeroDEAD, FUN=sum)

MicroABlonggenusbeforemeroDEADave <- aggregate(abundance~taxa + uniqID + Abx_relativeinfxn + Survived, data= MicroABlonggenusbeforemeroDEADave, FUN=mean)

#Plot post mero/pro versus vanc/pro for microbiota AB/mix
MicroABlonggenusaftermero<-MicroABlonggenus[grepl("aftermero", MicroABlonggenus$Abx_relativeinfxn),]

MicroABlonggenusaftermeroave<-aggregate(abundance~Sample + taxa + Microbiota + Abx_relativeinfxn, data= MicroABlonggenusaftermero, FUN=sum)
MicroABlonggenusaftermeroave$uniqID<-paste(MicroABlonggenusaftermeroave$Microbiota,MicroABlonggenusaftermeroave$Abx_relativeinfxn,sep="_")

MicroABlonggenusaftermeroave$normalabundance<-MicroABlonggenusaftermeroave$abundance/sum(MicroABlonggenusaftermeroave$abundance)*100

MicroABlonggenusaftervancave<-aggregate(abundance~Sample + taxa + Microbiota + Abx_relativeinfxn, data= MicroABlonggenusaftervanc, FUN=sum)
MicroABlonggenusaftervancave$uniqID<-paste(MicroABlonggenusaftervancave$Microbiota,MicroABlonggenusaftervancave$Abx_relativeinfxn,sep="_")

MicroABlonggenusaftervancave$normalabundance<-MicroABlonggenusaftervancave$abundance/sum(MicroABlonggenusaftervancave$abundance)*100

ggplot(MicroABlonggenusaftermerovancave, aes(uniqID, normalabundance, fill=taxa)) + geom_bar(stat = "identity", position="stack")+ theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1)) + scale_fill_manual(values=genuscolors)

MicroABlonggenusaftervancaveother<-ldply(
lapply(unique(MicroABlonggenusaftervancave$uniqID),function(x){rbind(MicroABlonggenusaftervancave[MicroABlonggenusaftervancave$normalabundance>=1 & MicroABlonggenusaftervancave$uniqID==x, c("taxa", "Microbiota","Abx_relativeinfxn","normalabundance","uniqID")],
                                                data.frame(taxa=c("Other"),

                                                uniqID=x
                                                ))})
)

MicroABlonggenusaftermeroaveother<-ldply(

                                                ))})
)
```
